mainEntity.name: What exactly is General Physical Preparedness (GPP)?

acceptedAnswer.text: General Physical Preparedness (GPP) is a foundational training approach focused on developing a broad range of physical qualities, rather than specializing in one. It enhances an individual's overall fitness capacity, including strength, endurance, flexibility, balance, and coordination. At Cave Training, our GPP programs are designed to build a robust physical base that supports daily activities and prepares you for more specialized physical challenges, reducing injury risk and improving overall life quality. This comprehensive approach ensures you have the physical readiness for various situations, whether it's hiking in the Santa Clarita Valley or participating in a new sport.
acceptedAnswer.description: General Physical Preparedness (GPP) is a foundational training approach that develops a broad range of physical qualities like strength, endurance, and flexibility. It builds a robust physical base for daily life and specialized activities, reducing injury risk.
